recipes.title: Crunchy Asian Cabbage Salad (Low Carb and Keto)
recipes.carbohydrateCaveat: JSON-LD carbohydrate value is a discovery filter only; the registered sourcer must verify total carbs and its serving basis on the public page.
ingredients: 1/4 cup Coconut Oil (Liquid or substitute a light flavored oil)
1/2 head Green Cabbage (Cored and finely shredded)
1/2 cup Coconut Oil (Liquid or substitute a light flavored oil)
1  Red Pepper (Cored, seeded and sliced very thin)
1/4 cup Scallion Greens (Sliced or substitute 2 tbsp finely diced shallots.)
1/2 tsp Ginger (Fresh, from a jar or 1/4 tsp dried ginger)
1 cup Snow Pea Pods (Optional) (Washed and cut in half)
recipes.description: A delightfully playful Asian Cabbage Salad recipe which is also high in healthy fats, dairy free, sugar free and delicious.
